name: Cancel Upcoming Remote Day
goal: Employee cancels a previously scheduled remote work day.
constraints: Remote day must exist in the employee's schedule.

phases.description: User requests to cancel a remote work day.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks for the date to cancel.

phases.description: User provides a valid date with a scheduled remote day.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms cancellation and updates schedule.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
